newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline stable, no U.S. trade despite numbers.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline stable, no U.S. trade despite numbers.

text.p: NWE gasoline was stable on Friday and no more cargoes were heard to have moved across the Atlantic despite U.S. prices which were attractive for much of the day.
Eurograde barges traded at $222 and $222.25 fob ARA and then at $221. Cargo talk was limited by a lack of product, after 150,000 tonnes was sold transatlantic on Wednesday.

Regular barges traded at $207.50. MTBE barges traded at $285. Prices remain trapped in a narrow range with U.S. arbitrage numbers not workable, and dealers unwilling to see the MTBE:gasoline ratio shrink far beyond 1.3:1.
